checkedAlternates.risk: AWS Lambda is a managed execution platform.
checkedAlternates.resolution: AWS Lambda specifically represents event-driven Function-as-a-Service (group-1), distinct from full app platforms (group-3).
EC2 provides raw virtual machines and networking (IaaS, group-2) rather than a managed runtime platform.
